decisions.note: Locator 47:413031 is verified as the exact Latin-script JP display name Turn the tables!. Preserve it unchanged, following the registry precedent for exact Latin skill titles rather than translating back from the Chinese bridge.

Locator 47:203652 is verified as JP 活路を拓く！. The image is literally opening/carving a viable way forward, while Chinese shifts it toward 'find a way out'; several concise Vietnamese imperatives are defensible, so defer.

Locator 47:201331 is verified as the identical JP title 技巧派. Its compact noun can be rendered as a technical school, technique specialist, or skillful type in Vietnamese; defer until the project's skill-title register selects one stable form.

Locator 47:108101111 is verified as JP ベッコベコに凹ます！, a strongly slangy Espoir City evolution title. The Chinese second-person phrasing is not authoritative for the exact voice or joke, so defer for character-aware treatment.
Locator 47:202972 is verified as JP 好機を捉えて. 'Nắm bắt thời cơ' is the standard concise Vietnamese expression and preserves the unambiguous opportunity-seizing meaning.

Locator 47:203882 is verified as JP 待ったなし, an idiom meaning there is no waiting/reprieve rather than simply 'make use of time'. Multiple Vietnamese idioms fit, so defer instead of locking the Chinese interpretation.

Locator 47:202442 is verified as JP やまっけ, a colloquial expression for speculative/chancy ambition. The Chinese noun phrase narrows the nuance; defer until a natural Vietnamese colloquial equivalent is reviewed.

Locator 47:108702111 is verified as JP 辻映りの妙技. The title contains a marked image/camera-related expression and character flavor not safely recoverable from Chinese 抢镜头 alone; defer rather than inventing the wordplay.

Locator 47:101041 is verified as JP 暁の御旗『葛城栄主』！. The quoted 葛城栄主 is stylized character/kanji wordplay associated with Katsuragi Ace; do not literally calque the Chinese proper-name rendering. Defer until the intended naming treatment is verified.
Locator 47:103202111 is verified as JP ラプラスの悪魔, the established 'Laplace's demon' concept. 'Con quỷ Laplace' is concise Vietnamese and preserves Laplace as the proper name.

Locator 47:101002211 is verified as JP 真剣勝負デス！. The title plays on the katakana デス in Taiki Shuttle's character voice; Chinese invents a gun-duel/Death pun that is not the source wording. Defer for voice-aware localization.

Locator 47:102802111 is verified as JP 手招きシュガーランタン. The mixed Japanese/English-flavor compound can be localized several natural ways, so defer until the project chooses a consistent treatment for this character's confectionery titles.

Locator 47:108401111 is verified as JP 嵐を呼ぶ破壊神. The meaning is clear, but Vietnamese has several equally plausible title forms ('thần hủy diệt gọi bão', 'phá hoại thần gọi bão tố', etc.); defer rather than freeze one stylistic choice.

Locator 47:110471 is verified as JP 未知との遭遇、即ち物語. This is a literary Zenno Rob Roy title whose exact relation is 'encounter with the unknown, that itself is a story', not simply 'embrace the unknown'; defer for literary-style review.

Locator 47:202392 is verified as JP しゃかりき, meaning working/running with all one's might. 'Hết mình' is concise natural Vietnamese and avoids the unnecessarily life-or-death literal flavor of Chinese 拼命.

Locator 47:203561 is verified as JP 一所懸命, an older/marked form related to 一生懸命. Several Vietnamese equivalents overlap with しゃかりき but carry different register, so defer to avoid collapsing two distinct skills.
Locator 47:202642 is verified as JP 一歩から, literally 'from one step'. The Chinese bridge 持之以恒 changes the concept to perseverance; the Vietnamese lock follows the verified Japanese title instead.

decisions.target_vi: Kiên trì tạo nên sức mạnh
decisions.note: Locator 47:204331 is verified as JP 継続は力なり, the fixed proverb that continued effort becomes strength. 'Kiên trì tạo nên sức mạnh' is a natural Vietnamese proverb-like rendering and stays distinct from 一歩から.

Locator 47:113501211 is verified as JP 針が交わる時. In Stay Gold's title context 針 may evoke clock/watch hands, but the repository evidence alone does not justify forcing that interpretation into the canonical Vietnamese wording; defer.

decisions.target_vi: Là bạn, cũng là đối thủ
ja: 友として、ライバルとして
decisions.note: Locator 47:300091 is verified as JP 友として、ライバルとして. 'Là bạn, cũng là đối thủ' naturally preserves the parallel relationship without adding hierarchy or intimacy beyond the source.
